The main ingredient in Thorne's **Joint Support Nutrients** (formerly AR-Encap) is **glucosamine sulfate**. On Thorne's US product page it is the largest ingredient, at 750 mg per 4-capsule serving.

The other active ingredients per serving are:
- Boswellia serrata extract: 350 mg
- Curcumin phytosome (Meriva): 250 mg
- Bromelain: 200 mg

The glucosamine is made from shellfish (crab and/or shrimp), so avoid it if you have a shellfish allergy.

Thorne's Brazil site lists a different version with less glucosamine (188 mg) plus MSM, so the formula may vary by country. Check the label on your bottle.

This question is about a supplement rather than the espresso setup, so I answered from a web search, not from the project's `knowledge/` files.

Sources:
- [Thorne – Joint Support Nutrients (US)](https://thorne.com/products/dp/ar-encap-reg)
- [Thorne – Joint Support Nutrients (Brazil)](https://br.thorne.com/products/dp/cdn-ar-encap-reg)
- [Fullscript – Joint Support Nutrients (formerly AR-Encap)](https://fullscript.com/en-US/catalog/products/ar-encap-240-vegcaps)
- [Mayo Clinic Store – Thorne Joint Support Nutrients](https://store.mayoclinic.com/thorne-joint-support-nutrients.html)
